newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Hermis bank active as Lithuanian shares slide.
newsitem.headline: Hermis bank active as Lithuanian shares slide.

text.p: Lithuanian shares fell on Friday with Hermis bank shares the most actively traded, the Lithuanian National Stock Exchange said.
Overall central market volume rose to 547,149 litas on Friday compared to a small 54,079 litas on January 2, while the group A index fell by 2.72 points to 1703.92.
The group A index follows 35 most active listings.
One of the largest commercial banks, Hermis, had turnover of 409,500 litas as its shares fell to 195 litas from 206.4.
Lithuanian Gas (Lietuvos Dujos) continued its slow rise and came to 1.41 litas from 1.4 on turnover of 59,703 litas.
Birzai Milk dairy went down to 8.15 litas from 8.2 in trade of 29.983 litas and all the shares on offer were bought.
Block trades worth 128,341 litas were also made on Friday and Hermis bank registered business of 27,300 litas at the price of 142 litas. Lithuanian Shipping company traded 69,750 litas at 4.65 litas.
Volume on the secondary T-bill market was 516,196 litas.
